changes.text: 「不可許」要写成条目：伊犁交涉中的一次说服
Turning "Not Acceptable" into a List of Clauses: One Act of Persuasion in the Ili Negotiation
全权大臣崇厚使俄，谈成一份条约；崇厚为朝士所纠，议了很久，议不出结果。作者的一种解释是：难处不在于要不要伊犁，而在于约已经签了；认账，是失地失利权在先；翻案，得有人去谈，还得有让对方重新坐下来的筹码。

Chong Hou, a plenipotentiary envoy sent to Russia, concluded a treaty. Chong Hou was censured by court officials, and the debate dragged on toward no conclusion. One reading, the author's, is that the trouble was never whether Ili mattered, but that the treaty had already been signed. Accept it, and the lost territory and compromised rights stood as a fait accompli. Repudiate it, and someone had to go back to the table carrying enough leverage to make the other side sit down again.
僵局之中，左宗棠上奏，逐条点出哪几处不可许，主张「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」。奏上获嘉许，他于是自请出屯哈密。六年四月，他「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。七月，他奉诏入都备顾问，由锦棠接替。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁。

Into that deadlock stepped Zuo Zongtang with a memorial. Item by item he named the terms that must not be accepted, and argued that one should "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory." The throne commended it, and he then asked leave to move his headquarters to Hami. In the fourth month of the sixth year he "set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage," and reached Hami in the fifth month. In the seventh month he was summoned to the capital and Jintang took his place. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded and Ili was returned.
其时有伊犁之变，朝廷诏左宗棠分兵屯肃州，他遣徐占彪带六千人前往。传中另记一事：俄方与土耳其交战时，金顺请求乘虚袭击伊犁，左宗棠不许，说「不可。師不以正，彼有辭矣」。

At the time of the Ili crisis, the court ordered Zuo Zongtang to detach troops to garrison Suzhou, and he sent Xu Zhanbiao with six thousand men. The biography records a separate episode: when Russia was at war with Turkey, Jin Shun asked to exploit the opening and strike Ili. Zuo refused: "No. If our army does not act from a position of right, we hand them their excuse."
俄方开出通商、分界、偿款三项条件，崇厚在俄定约，动作很快——史书用一个「遽」字：「崇厚遽定約」。约成之后，崇厚为朝士所纠，朝廷议论长久不能决定。条约是签了，崇厚却遭纠劾，议久不决，事情悬在半空。

The Russian side laid out three heads of demand: trade, borders, and indemnity. Chong Hou concluded the treaty on the spot, and he moved fast — the history reaches for one blunt word: "Chong Hou hastily concluded the treaty." Chong Hou was then censured by court officials, and the debate went on without decision. The treaty had been signed, yet Chong Hou had been censured and the debate stalled; the whole affair hung in mid-air.
左宗棠的奏疏先算账。自俄国盘踞伊犁，蚕食不止，新疆有日蹙百里之势；俄国视伊犁为外府，我方一索地，它就索偿卢布五百万元。「是俄還伊犁，於俄無損，我得伊犁，僅一荒郊」。作者的一种解释是：名义上的收复，实利仍在对方手里。数字照史书所录，未经核实。

Zuo's memorial opened by doing the arithmetic. Since Russia occupied Ili it had been nibbling away without pause, until Xinjiang looked set to shrink by a hundred li a day. Russia treated Ili as an outer treasury: the moment we asked for the land back, it demanded five million rubles in compensation. "So Russia's return of Ili would cost Russia nothing; what we would get is only a wasteland on the outskirts." One reading, the author's, is that the recovery would be nominal, and the real profit would stay on the other side. The figure is recorded as the history gives it and has not been verified.
奏中提出的对策是：「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」，末了又说「臣雖衰慵無似，敢不勉旃」。议论与战阵不是二选一，是有先后的两步。

The course the memorial proposed was: "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory" — closing with "Though I am old, tired, and of no great ability, how dare I not do my best." Negotiation and battle were not alternatives to choose between; they were two steps in a fixed order.
作者推断，这道奏疏的分量来自结构，不只来自立场。它把反对拆成条目——界务一处、商务一处，各自说明为何不可许；把方案写成顺序——先议论、后战阵。随后崇厚得罪去，朝廷命曾纪泽使俄更前约，这一段是有记录的。奏疏获嘉许之后，他又自请出屯哈密，把第二步落到具体的人和地上。

The author's reading is that this memorial carried weight through its structure, not merely its stance. It broke the objection into items — one for the border terms, one for trade, each with its own stated reason for refusal. It wrote the plan as a sequence: negotiation first, battle second. That Chong Hou was then punished and dismissed, and Zeng Jize sent to revise the earlier treaty, is on the record. After the memorial was commended, he volunteered to hold Hami, making the second step concrete — a named man in a named place.

dispositions.rationale: 中文标题引语改为与证据字形一致的「不可許」；英文标题原样重给以保持同步。
「為朝士所糾」承接主语崇厚，中英文都改为崇厚被纠劾，不再写成条约被纠。

evidence.quote: 崇厚遽定約，為朝士所糾，議久不決

dispositions.rationale: 删去证据无载的“送回朝廷”/sent home to the capital，改为全权大臣崇厚使俄定约。

evidence.quote: 詔遣全權大臣崇厚使俄

dispositions.rationale: 在和议成之前补入七月宗棠奉诏入都、由锦棠接替一事，中英同步，避免读者把抵哈密直接读成和议的原因。

evidence.quote: 七月，詔宗棠入都備顧問，以錦棠代之

dispositions.rationale: “伊犁之变后”改为“其时有伊犁之变”，英文改为At the time of the Ili crisis，与原文「是時」的时间关系一致。

evidence.quote: 而是時有伊犁之變，詔宗棠分兵屯肅州

dispositions.rationale: 在本段证据中补列QSG4122-E5，以支持崇厚使俄一句。

evidence.quote: 詔遣全權大臣崇厚使俄

dispositions.rationale: 中英文两处都把被纠劾者改为崇厚，删去用于条约的impeached。

evidence.quote: 崇厚遽定約，為朝士所糾

dispositions.rationale: 把“名义上的收复，实利仍在对方”明确标为作者的解释，中英同步。

evidence.quote: 是俄還伊犁，於俄無損，我得伊犁，僅一荒郊

dispositions.rationale: 删去把E9与E10串成因果的“既然……就要”，改为直接陈述奏中提出的对策，中英同步。

evidence.quote: 為今之計，當先之以議論

dispositions.rationale: 按原文顺序改为崇厚得罪去在前、命曾纪泽使俄更前约在后，中英同步。

evidence.quote: 崇厚得罪去，命曾紀澤使俄，更前約
